entities.name: Query protein bL27
observations: 88 aa protein with exact sequence match to reviewed Lawsonia intracellularis ribosomal protein bL27 (UniProt O87885).
Strongly basic sequence: predicted pI 11.05 and charge at pH 7 of +13.75.
Contains Ribosomal_L27 Pfam domain PF01016.25 at positions 2–79, i-Evalue 2.2e-36.

entities.name: Large ribosomal subunit protein bL27
observations: Curated homolog annotations assign bL27 to the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit.
Annotated as a structural constituent of the ribosome and associated with translation.
The query has 100% identity and 100% coverage to reviewed UniProt O87885; additional reviewed homologs show 82.1% identity over approximately 95.5% query coverage.
